campaign: Hatchet-derived process control: gate wall, selection coverage, lane overlap and governed promotion on existing Go owners
doctrine: Work and commit only in the overgo_hatchet worktree; do not push. Owner priorities 2026-09-09, judged by the phase wall table every gate prints: (1) safe selection and evidence reuse, since the last gate ran 234 packages with zero receipt reuse; (2) fast failure before expensive work, on master's a20ce59e ordering (vet and build before acceptance, edited owners first); (3) measured concurrency that shares GPU capacity between correctness workloads, changed packages first, overlap evaluated without recreating contention; (4) automatic mechanical repairs that refresh derived files before the candidate freezes, preserve reviewed thresholds and bind verification to the resulting candidate. The lane is judged by fewer unnecessary executions, faster failure detection and shorter successful gates with the same regression detection; scheduling machinery that does not reduce executed work is refused. Master's reviewed intake (74e8ea80, cbb2a24d, 89deb42c, a20ce59e) is the design authority: the full gate stays mandatory for every commit, no denominator shrinks, no skipped check earns credit, semantic literal authority stays as master decided, and the lane re-lands none of what master excluded without an independently bound correctness test and a measured validation benefit. No Hatchet source is copied; concepts are ported onto existing Go owners. Every row lands with one acceptance test in the owning package, named in its file-guarded verify, and commits through the plan-bound gate. Host rows land first; the measured rows precede master's batch-promotion row, which alone completes validation-batch-control; lane rows master's intake declined stay last and are re-planned before dispatch; master's retained rows are assigned to master and never dispatch here. Master's 2ef953fa is the device admission authority: the gate's shared lease per host test batch, the measurement children that wait under their parent deadline and processcontrol.AwaitResource are reused, never duplicated; the lane adds no second wait loop and no refusal of foreign holders. One package-graph fact names the packages that need the device, and selection, batch order, the device lane and the lane exclusion resolver read it. Each lane cycle lands a plan-only commit, so plan-only commits are measured as their own gate shape.

items.title: Exclude the GPU lanes on host-only changes and bind subprocess consumers by declared edges

steps.title: Classify each package's runtime reach from its source and bind only the commands and files it names
steps.rationale: Priority one. Every package that imports os is bound to every repository root as an opaque reader, so any change selects about 234 packages and invalidates every package receipt: the last gate executed 234 packages with zero reuse. A deterministic analyzer classifies each package from the literals in its execution and file calls: a literal repository command binds that command's package closure, a literal repository path binds that file, the test binary itself and named external tools bind nothing, temporary files bind nothing, and a program or path the source does not name keeps the broad binding and is reported with its reason. Selection and package identities follow the classified edges, so unaffected packages keep their receipts across commits; the lane exclusion resolver reads the same classification. Master's subprocess cases (command output, shared launcher, renamed and deleted command, unowned protocol file) and the lane matrix stay green. Acceptance for pace is the phase wall table of the gates before and after this row: fewer executed packages and checks, earlier failure detection, a shorter successful gate, and the same seeded regressions detected; scheduling machinery that does not reduce executed work is refused.

items.title: Run the GPU lanes and the test groups concurrently under the existing admission

steps.title: Order device work first under master's shared lease, then overlap the test groups and the lanes
steps.rationale: Priority three, consolidated on master's 2ef953fa. The gate now takes one shared device lease per host test batch and waits for admission instead of failing, so the remaining loss is order and serialization: seven of the lane's eight gate attempts failed because the device packages ran minutes into the batch, after an exclusive holder had returned, and the device and browser lanes run seven minutes serial after the test phase. One package-graph fact names the packages whose tests need the device, replacing master's dependent-directory scan in the batch admission, the device lane's module ownership match and the lane exclusion resolver's copy. Within each group the changed source owners run first, then the device packages while the lease is held, then the rest; the dependent group starts once the changed owners pass; the device and browser lanes overlap the host test phase with store-writer admission through AwaitResource on the lane store lock, since both lanes write the lane store and its OS exclusion admits one writer. The device lane's own commands still claim the device exclusively without waiting (the merge gate of 2ef953fa passed its whole test phase under the shared lease and then failed in cuda-smoke against a foreign holder), so the device lane takes its exclusive claim through the same AwaitResource wait under the parent budget. Nothing is skipped: the same packages and lanes run. Acceptance for pace is the phase wall table of the gates before and after this row: fewer executed packages and checks, earlier failure detection, a shorter successful gate, and the same seeded regressions detected; scheduling machinery that does not reduce executed work is refused.

items.title: Cut the gate wall: measure it, front-load the validate checks, repair the mechanical findings, overlap the admission chain

steps.title: Run the independent static checks concurrently, keeping master's prerequisites
steps.rationale: Priority two. Master's a20ce59e already runs vet and build before acceptance and binds the candidate census in the early modern-Go phase; the static checks still run one after another behind profile and architecture. The checks with no data dependency on each other run in one wave after their declared prerequisites, every finding printed at once, before acceptance; the phase order inside the wave is by declared dependency only; the shared gate state they write is guarded. The full gate stays mandatory; nothing is skipped or credited. Acceptance for pace is the phase wall table of the gates before and after this row: fewer executed packages and checks, earlier failure detection, a shorter successful gate, and the same seeded regressions detected; scheduling machinery that does not reduce executed work is refused.

steps.title: Apply the mechanical repairs through one registry before the candidate freezes, preserving reviewed thresholds
steps.rationale: Priority four. The gate already repairs one finding by itself, the stale closure rebind in the magics phase; the others (gofmt, the modern-Go census and baseline, the harness surface baseline, the clone baseline within its ceiling) are refused late and re-gated by hand, and every re-gate pays the full wall. One repair registry lists each derived file with its writer, its reviewed thresholds and the phase that consumes it; before the candidate freezes the gate applies every repair whose input is the candidate source, records each as a staged repair in the audit and binds verification to the repaired candidate. A repair that would move a reviewed threshold or ceiling is refused with the delta. The existing closure rebind becomes the first registry entry, not a second path. Acceptance for pace is the phase wall table of the gates before and after this row: fewer executed packages and checks, earlier failure detection, a shorter successful gate, and the same seeded regressions detected; scheduling machinery that does not reduce executed work is refused.

steps.title: Compute the candidate tree once per gate and reuse the parsed plan across admission and commit
steps.rationale: Master owns admission recovery (b7b689c7, 5dec105b, 2ef953fa); the lane removes repeated work only. The drift check snapshots the candidate tree before every check (a temporary index, read-tree, add and write-tree per check) and the plan document is parsed in admission, in the docs phase and again in the commit phase. The candidate tree key is computed once after preparation and compared by content hash of the planned paths thereafter; the parsed plan and the captured index state are carried in the gate context. Measured by the wall of the seventeen checks outside their own work and the commit phase wall. Acceptance for pace is the phase wall table of the gates before and after this row: fewer executed packages and checks, earlier failure detection, a shorter successful gate, and the same seeded regressions detected; scheduling machinery that does not reduce executed work is refused.

items.title: Stop paying a full gate for commits that change no Go input

steps.title: Give plan-only and receipt-only commits a gate that runs the validate checks and the commit barrier
steps.rationale: Every lane cycle lands a plan-only commit (a re-plan or a merge row) and pays the full gate for it: the last plan-only gates ran the same nine-minute test phase as a source change because the plan is a runtime-named input of the plan packages. A commit whose planned paths change no Go input, no kernel and no runtime-named file of any package except the plan's own readers runs the admission chain, the validate wave, the plan's own readers and the commit barrier; every other phase records itself as inapplicable with the reason, never as reused or passed. The next source commit runs the full gate as before. The plan structure tests stay in the plan-only shape. Acceptance for pace is the phase wall table of the gates before and after this row: fewer executed packages and checks, earlier failure detection, a shorter successful gate, and the same seeded regressions detected; scheduling machinery that does not reduce executed work is refused.

items.title: End lane servers with the run

steps.title: End lane servers with the run and report their device release in the run receipt
steps.rationale: Master's 2ef953fa owns device admission: shared batches wait, measurement children wait under their parent deadline, and device tasks report not_busy only after the process tree exits. The lane keeps the one remaining hole: a browser lane that fails leaves overgo-server holding the device until an operator kills it, and the next gate's shared lease then waits its whole budget. The lane server is a supervised child of the lane run, ends with the run's terminal receipt on every exit path, and the receipt records the device release. No refusal of foreign holders and no second admission path. Acceptance for pace is the phase wall table of the gates before and after this row: fewer executed packages and checks, earlier failure detection, a shorter successful gate, and the same seeded regressions detected; scheduling machinery that does not reduce executed work is refused.

items.title: Make a lane merge one command and one gate

steps.title: Teach plan -prepare-merge the first-parent-target lane case end to end
steps.rationale: The merge of 2ef953fa took a manual sequence the lane repeats every cycle: stash the candidate, merge with no commit, keep the lane plan, resolve the census files, republish the census, import master's closure decisions, rebind, add and assign the merge row, and only then gate. plan -prepare-merge learns the first-parent-target lane case end to end: it performs that sequence, refuses when several worktrees sit on master's commit only if the projection cannot be resolved, and leaves one gate to run. Measured by the wall from the merge request to the merge gate start. Acceptance for pace is the phase wall table of the gates before and after this row: fewer executed packages and checks, earlier failure detection, a shorter successful gate, and the same seeded regressions detected; scheduling machinery that does not reduce executed work is refused.

steps.title: Derive the audio reference store and data roots from the lane's declared roots instead of the operator's environment
steps.rationale: Two of the lane's gate attempts failed only because OVERGO_AUDIO_REFERENCE_STORE was not exported: the audio parity acceptances derive their datasets and model roots from the reference store's parent directory, and the gate exports the lane store when the variable is unset, which names roots the lane does not have. The gate derives the reference store from the declared data roots (local-models.json) the same way the tests derive theirs, records the derivation in the environment evidence, and the tests read the declared roots instead of the store's parent. No operator environment is needed for a lane gate. Acceptance for pace is the phase wall table of the gates before and after this row: fewer executed packages and checks, earlier failure detection, a shorter successful gate, and the same seeded regressions detected; scheduling machinery that does not reduce executed work is refused.

items.title: Resolve the dispatch once per turn and hand it to the harness as data

steps.title: Add plan -next -json and have the stop hook and the loop consume it
steps.verify: test -f cmd/plan/dispatch_json_test.go && go test ./cmd/plan -run '^TestDispatchJSONMatchesProse$' -count=1 && test -f cmd/loophook/dispatch_test.go && go test ./cmd/loophook -run '^TestLoopHookConsumesDispatchJSON$' -count=1
steps.rationale: A loop turn runs the plan tool five times, each rebuilding completion authority from git history and the store, the stop hook re-implements the resolver, and the loop parses the prose dispatch back into a struct. The plan tool prints the dispatch as JSON, the completion authority is cached on HEAD and the store head, and the hook and the loop consume the JSON; the dead bounded-request marker is removed.

items.title: Catalog a literal in one transaction

steps.title: Fold propose, triage and import into one closure-scan command
steps.rationale: A new named constant or policy literal costs three tool runs plus prose, and the staged-surface and unconsumed-surface rules enforce the same fact twice with a hand-written entry each. One command takes the name and the understanding, proposes, binds and imports in one store transaction, and the staged entry is generated from the failing check's own output. Semantic literal authority stays exactly as master decided; only the mechanics change.

items.title: Complete bounded process control after E4B acceptance

steps.title: Prove selective, restart-safe verification and governed batch promotion
steps.verify: go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestPreflightReportsValidateFindings|TestPreflightSeparatesSkippedChecks|TestPreflightNeverRepairsStore|TestPreflightRejectsCombinedInspection|TestGateStartIndexAdoptsStatRefreshUnderSameTree|TestGateStartIndexRefusesAndPreservesLaterUnplannedStaging)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestCheckpointPersistenceSurvivesKill|TestCheckpointMemoCoversEveryCommand|TestChangeSelectiveVerificationShadow|TestBatchedGateCostEvidence)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestIndependentPackageEvidenceAcceptance|TestGovernedBatchDeclarationAcceptance|TestProjectedMergePreflightBeforeVerification|TestGateReusesUnchangedCheckEvidence|TestPackageSelectiveReuse)$' -count=1 && test -f internal/gate/batch_promotion_test.go && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestBatchPromotionControl$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestReusedCheckpointCompletionAuthorityAcceptance$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/repoanalysis -run '^(TestDocsHoldNoUnplannedBinaries|TestDocsInventoryPolicy)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestPreflightRejectsUnplannedDocsBeforeStore$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestChangeSelectionUnownedRuntimeInputs$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/plan -run '^TestBatchFlush' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestCandidateGoPhasesExcludeIgnoredSource$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestBatchEvidence' -count=1
steps.rationale:
Lane execution of master's row, adopted verbatim from master 43a2c7aa9858 on 2026-09-08. Master has since landed the required selection matrix, terminal evidence restart and cross-worktree GPU admission tests its checkpoints name; the remaining obligation is TestBatchPromotionControl and the integration gate, which alone completes the parent. The audio merge already supplies step-local verification batches, exact subordinate completion/recovery evidence and independent per-package cache reuse. Master adds early projected-merge receipt preflight. Preserve these lower bounds; do not implement them again. The remaining work is checkpoint commits without premature parent completion, durable outstanding obligations bound to cumulative changes, mandatory escalation and measured scheduling through the existing plan/gate/OvergoDB owners.

Implement a concrete governed checkpoint path in cmd/gate: record implemented versus verified versus promoted states without pruning the parent. Persist outstanding checks with exact cumulative source/fixture/environment identities, survive interruption/restart, reject orphaning through replan or branch changes, and require one complete final integration gate. Persistence, authentication, concurrency, kernels, public contracts and gate-policy changes immediately trigger their required checks; the controller may adjust scheduling only inside declared limits. Until this exists, full gates remain mandatory for commits. Batch related implementation by capability/dependency, not commit counts; narrower diagnostics do not grant promotion.

Report elapsed wall from the committed run measurement separately from summed phase durations and estimated step time avoided. Include independently reused packages, executed checks, outstanding obligations, failures found and invalidation causes. Privatize gate-only cost types and functions, migrate every caller, and retain exact reporting tests; no additional reporting API. Use the recent GUI merge failures (1757.2s and 1137.7s after successful verification) and final 952.9s run as recorded before evidence for early refusal and scheduling efficiency; do not claim these wall times predict another model. Prove saving and unchanged regression detection on repeated controlled failure/restart/replan cases, including one failed or unavailable package beside a reusable passing package. The exclusive GPU lease finding evidence:sha256:0f4b6d07607b3fa8ee6ee7f320646e5dbbd5b38b025a19c2046d54aed7fa4b4e remains open: consumers must enforce admitted resources before isolated measurements. Never silently weaken acceptance, fabricate fixture evidence or credit skipped cases. Owner directive 2026-09-06 makes this bounded process-control integration the next dispatch and a prerequisite of the remaining E4B acceptance. Finish the declared checkpoints, then return immediately to E4B; adaptive scheduler tuning, broad API cleanup and unrelated infrastructure are deferred. CPU dataset/reference preparation may proceed independently, but isolated evidence requires enforced GPU admission.

Latest before evidence: audio merge cf3f5eb1 passed in 896.5 seconds after an interrupted run and a 592.4-second failure caused by a stale machine-local dataset root. All four explicit acceptances passed, but the later package run resolved the corpus through a different root. Preserve one resolved input contract across acceptance and package tests; validate required paths/identities before expensive verification. The corrected root changes environment identity and correctly invalidates earlier evidence. The successful gate executed 189 packages and credited none of its 472 skipped dependent fixtures. Classify those by affected required acceptance versus optional/platform coverage: resolve every required missing fixture; record unsupported-platform exclusions with exact reasons and never count them as passing. Add prompt failure reporting with the exact package/test while preserving every unrun obligation. Persist successful terminal package reports during process execution, not only after the whole group returns, and prove process-kill/restart reuse without credit for incomplete packages. Keep process supervision, recovery, rename scope, clone/style/permanent-authority preflight and exclusive GPU admission under their existing owners. Checkpoint policy changes require full existing checks and cannot self-authorize a weaker gate.

Selection acceptance: classify cumulative changes to implementation, tests, documentation, fixtures/artifacts/configuration and gate policy using the existing dependency owners. Include transitive consumers, both rename paths, build tags, device mode, toolchain and resolved input identities. Produce a reviewable explanation for every selected, reused or excluded check and every invalidation. Unknown impact broadens the scope. Before enabling narrower enforcement, shadow-compare with the full required gate on a frozen matrix of representative historical changes and injected known failures, including cross-package, fixture-only, rename, kernel, persistence and gate-policy changes. Require zero omitted required checks or missed seeded regressions; preserve the full matrix denominator and actual timings. A documentation-only change may reuse independent runtime evidence only when the dependency proof supports it. Gate-policy changes themselves use the existing full gate, never their proposed reduced policy.

Restart acceptance: publish each terminal passing package/checkpoint atomically to OvergoDB as it finishes, independently of a later failed, skipped or killed sibling. Bind deferred obligations to the cumulative batch and exact dependencies; demonstrate kill/restart, replan and scope expansion without losing obligations or accepting partial/zero-match runs. Report the precise failing package/test promptly and repair in scope before closure.

GPU acceptance: use the existing resource owner to exclude competing consumers of the same physical GPU across worktrees and stores, for the entire admitted run. Test contention, process death, stale-owner recovery and release; unexpected competing use invalidates isolated performance/resource claims. GPU reservation must not serialize independent CPU preparation.

Integration acceptance: TestBatchPromotionControl must exercise implemented/checkpointed, verified and promoted transitions, outstanding-check refusal, all mandatory escalation classes and final cumulative acceptance. Compare cold and resumed verification on the same frozen change matrix; report wall time by phase, reused/executed checks, repeated model loads, outstanding obligations and failures detected. Require measured reduction in repeated work on unchanged dependencies without weaker acceptance; record observed savings rather than inventing a universal speedup floor. Scheduling may reorder or reuse proven checks within declared limits, never alter denominators or thresholds.

Landed lower bounds: checkpoint memo with compound-command coverage/refusal; per-check retry persistence with subprocess restart proof; three synthetic selection counterexamples; acceptance/failure/cost telemetry; batch flush declarations. The reviewed 719c32cb intake adds diagnostic preflight, explicit skip reporting, no closure repair during preflight, mutually exclusive modes, and stat-only index refresh recovery. Retain their bound tests. Cache persistence is not cumulative OvergoDB obligations; synthetic import graphs are not the full selection matrix; flush declarations are not promotion; summed step durations are not parallel elapsed wall.

Remaining correctness proofs: selection covers external/subprocess consumers, fixtures, build modes, renames, kernels, persistence and gate policy; unknown reachability keeps required checks. GPU ownership uses a stable physical-resource domain across worktrees and stores, with OS-held exclusion, live-owner contention, process/child death and restart tests; stale heartbeat never grants ownership. Promotion reevaluates elapsed intervals at current time even when all checkpoints are already recorded, survives restart, and consumes every required obligation before parent completion. Exercise exact boundary, no-new-checkpoint and trailing-obligation cases. Reuse existing owners; no parallel scheduler.

Excluded from master: Hatchet lane plan, open lane work, heartbeat-based device takeover, static dependency exclusions, automatic literal exemptions, conditional workflows and broader scheduling/replay features. These are not E4B prerequisites or presumed future imports. Any later admission needs an independently bound correctness test and measured validation benefit. Preserve semantic literal authority; lexical zero/one, min/max, math calls, shadowed imports and strconv arguments are not automatic policy exemptions.

GUI intake selection coverage: extend the frozen full-gate shadow matrix with embedded JavaScript/assets, browser subprocesses, provider declaration and key changes, proxy admission, remote run-record classification and plan lane dispatch. Trace consumers through embedding, environment inputs and subprocess contracts, not Go imports alone. Authentication, persistence, public contracts and gate-policy changes retain mandatory escalation. Keep TestGeneratorUsesUpdatedKey in internal/remoterelay and the media-to-chat attachment case in TestWebUIBrowserAcceptance as bound lower bounds; browser acceptance must run through cmd/webui-lane, never receive credit from its outside-lane skip. Reuse terminal passing checks only with exact independence evidence; do not rerun a whole model bundle for a UI-only change when that proof exists. Treat harness snapshot migrations as explicit reviewed scope changes with measured before/after deltas, never automatic normalization of a failed ratchet. The full selection and promotion proofs remain open.

Execution split after the terminal-evidence and resource-lifetime probes: land evidence-resource-producer through the full existing gate, then complete this parent. Reuse its exact passing receipts; do not rebuild the producer for every acceptance addition. Retain the full selection-shadow denominator, cumulative restart/replan obligations, time-only and trailing flush cases, mandatory escalation, real cold/resumed wall measurements, and unmanaged GPU interference invalidation. Producer completion grants no narrower gate policy and no model acceptance. Candidate-source isolation: an ignored tmp/gui-review test fragment entered go vet ./... during producer gate 6 and failed on an out-of-package helper. The local tmp module boundary removes that immediate scratch contamination, but is not durable gate authority. Prove build, vet, package discovery and execution consume the exact candidate source while ignoring unrelated scratch; retain deliberately bound external fixtures and test ignored Go files both in a scratch directory and beside a tracked package. Unknown required inputs must still broaden checks.

Preserve transaction-refreshed, retained evidence handles during checkpoint integration. TestTerminalEvidenceRestart must retain exact durable-result equality, independent receipt publication, competing revocation and publication-error refusal. Measure store opens and publication wall time beside full-gate wall time; do not infer campaign throughput from the bounded receipt fixture. Share the existing evidence owner across checkpoint and final verification; remove displaced factories and forwarding wrappers with their caller migrations.

Retain TestAbandonedGateAdmission when integrating checkpoints: only the acquired OS gate lock authorizes recovery, independent of heartbeat age. Preserve one typed cancellation, exact package receipts and outstanding obligations; ambiguous/corrupt authority, commit intent and post-commit debt retain their existing explicit recovery paths. Do not add a second liveness service, expiry-based takeover or duplicate recovery implementation.

The subprocess counterexample reopens the historical two-package scope savings claim for 1939094b: opaque command execution was absent from that projection. Keep the recorded 973.8s incident as history, not a validated narrower baseline. The full matrix must compare against the corrected consumer graph, account for conservative subprocess costs, and prove any later static-target or fixture-independence refinement before reducing checks. Preserve per-batch digest reuse with identical input IDs and fresh reads after each batch; never carry file digests across candidate changes.

Post-merge priorities: reuse the landed checkpoint-completion binding and shared execution/cache eligibility from the audio intake; do not rebuild them. Retain TestReusedCheckpointCompletionAuthorityAcceptance as a lower bound beside cumulative obligation and promotion proofs. Move the existing documentation-inventory acceptance into the existing preflight owner without weakening it: the GUI intake spent 557.8s before rejecting nine historical PNG copies, while its diagnostic preflight had passed. The corrected GUI gate executed 213 packages in 969.2s, including repeated audio resume work. Prove static subprocess target and external-fixture independence before reducing those repeats; compare full/selected regression detection and real cold/resumed cost. Include GUI embedded assets, active-provider pagination over retired history, conversation ownership/recovery, settings and layout audits in the selection matrix. Preserve the full existing policy until these proofs pass.

Current implementation counterexample: a changed repository-level runtime file read through os.ReadFile selected zero tests and retained a stale package receipt. Bind opaque runtime file readers through the same input graph used for selection and identity, retaining independent receipts and excluding generated test-main imports from ownership. Cover repository-level, sibling-package and embedded inputs. The documentation inventory now shares the existing repoanalysis policy with gate preflight, refusing all nine misplaced GUI screenshots before census/store access. Preserve these regression checks. Single-key accumulation removes its redundant map. Add empty/negative/overflow/pre-origin refusals alongside durable elapsed-only scheduling in this parent; these behaviors are not implemented by the prerequisite. Complete persistence and actual scheduling integration before promotion.

Land batch-terminal-obligations as the bounded durable-evidence producer, then finish the remaining control boundary. Checkpoint results use typed AgentObligation/AgentObligationResolution and a cumulative gate record in the canonical store; the retry file is only a projection. BatchFlush.Advance owns immutable state transitions; no constructor, duplicate accumulator state or independent reset authority remains. Actual elapsed-only scheduling and governed checkpoint promotion still require their executable integration proofs. Keep full gates mandatory.

After store release, Windows resource-job membership confirmed a sibling full gate and its package-test descendants retained the physical GPU while no compute workload was reported. Derive per-case and aggregate WER/CER bounds from matched native FP32/BF16 SDPA references before evaluating Go. Require complete termination for all 32; repeated timing uses one warmup and three measured rounds under isolated resource ownership. A budget interruption leaves the denominator incomplete.

Query the registered catalog and C:/Users/jeffm/overgo/datasets for appropriate image/text/video labels and available assets. The prior inventory had 84 entries, 47 available and 37 unavailable; refresh it rather than treating those counts as current truth. Find/acquire missing required assets and register unregistered datasets through existing owners. Store one evidence bundle for the model, then feed existing memory/benchmark/modality reports from those same records. Master owns validation and numerical/admission repairs; GUI owns HTTP implementation, audio owns native streaming and training. No projector promotion until all declared media modes have evidence.

steps.rationale: The E4B ladder reportedly grew from 14 GB loaded to 39 GB after rung 32768. items.title: Recover small-head decode throughput without losing long-context correctness

steps.title: Recover small-head decode throughput without losing long-context correctness
steps.rationale: The reviewed short-context Qwen2.5-0.5B rate fell from 295 to 139 tokens/s while E4B remained within about three percent. First remove capacity-sized host upload from BenchmarkDecodeAttention's timed iteration and keep caches resident; measure allocation/upload separately. Run the actual benchmark with -bench '^BenchmarkDecodeAttention$' and device opt-in, not only -run. Compare repeated isolated before/after runs across short contexts, 4096 boundaries, tile boundaries, long contexts and representative head geometries. Keep split-key correctness, NLL and memory guarantees; recover the measured short-context gap within predeclared noise bounds without trading away larger-context throughput. Bind both kernel parity and end-to-end Qwen/E4B assertions. Remove capacity-wide work and redundant transfers before introducing another dispatch policy; retain one shared path wherever parity permits.
